explanation.question_quote: Unlike previous episodes of chest pain, this one is unresponsive to nitroglycerin.
explanation.sentence: The patient has severe chest pain that does not respond to nitroglycerin, along with ST-segment elevation.
This presentation is consistent with an acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction.

explanation.question_quote: He is discharged within 2 weeks. He comes back 3 weeks later for follow-up.
explanation.sentence: He returns three weeks after discharge, which places the follow-up roughly three to five weeks after the infarction.
During the two-to-eight-week healing phase, a gray-white collagenous scar becomes visible as it grows inward from the infarct margins, even though scarring is not yet complete.
Yellow necrotic pallor and a red granulation-tissue border are characteristic of earlier stages of healing.
